name: "Kung Pao" Chicken Wings with Peanuts & Broccoli-Water Chestnut Slaw

ingredients.name: chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 500°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch and salt, then toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g chicken wings, split with tips removed
cornstarch
salt

instructions.primary_message: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
1 red bell pepper
½ small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Place both in a small saucepan along with water, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, cornstarch, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
rice vinegar
1 tbsp brown sugar
cornstarch
1 tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Place saucepan over medium heat and cook, whisking occasionally, until sauce thickens, 3-4 minutes. Transfer to a clean medium bowl and set aside for the wings.
Place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in another medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
neutral vegetable oil
rice vinegar
salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining green onions for serving.)
Roughly chop peanuts. Add half to the bowl. (Reserve remaining peanuts for serving.)
Drain and rinse water chestnuts; roughly chop. Add to the bowl, along with broccoli slaw, and stir to combine. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
113 g water chestnuts
½ (340 g) pkg broccoli slaw

instructions.primary_message: When the wings are done, add to the bowl with the sauce and toss to coat.
To serve, divide wings and slaw between plates; top wings with reserved green onions and peanuts. Enjoy!
